articles.title: China Services Gauge Unexpectedly Dips for First Time Since July
articles.excerpt: China’s services activity unexpectedly grew at a slower rate for the first time since July, a private survey showed, as business confidence eased and firms lowered their selling prices despite intensifying inflation in input costs.
articles.summary: 一项私人调查显示，中国服务业活动扩张速度意外放缓，为7月以来首次；企业信心减弱，并在投入成本通胀加剧的情况下下调销售价格。

articles.title: Can India’s Debt-Fueled Spending Survive Higher Rates?
articles.excerpt: India’s household borrowing surged 36% in a year, raising questions about how much consumer spending is being powered by debt and whether that growth can last as interest rates rise. Ruchi Bhatia explains. (Source: Bloomberg)
articles.summary: 印度家庭借贷一年内激增36%，引发疑问：消费支出在多大程度上由债务支撑，以及在利率上升环境下这种增长能否持续。彭博记者Ruchi Bhatia对此作出解析。
